ModMetaData.description:
SexSlaveCraft 2.4.8 (TieJin Modify) 孕母第七特化、三态人格印记、孕前设置与生成／出生处理、面向合格成年对象的终极同场受孕技能，以及PNA／部位频率属性、空壳六需求和调教员便捷操作。 新增仅RimWorld 1.7；1.6／Common保留SSC 2.4.1冻结基线。孕母新选需锁链阶段3与完整子宫；成功建孕后7天冷却，中断不建孕不扣成功冷却。印记随人格、孕前选择随身体；当前主人禁止人格排泄。 调教员可显式指派并启用工作或就地启用，默认优先级3、保留已有优先级。复制体、整体独立框架及房间效果尚未开发或暂缓。 继承个人控制、浪漫／心情／日志、敏感度、PNA生产、身体开发、文化／医美、九把武器、凝胶外观及人格转移。本版功能已有分批实机认可；繁英俄浪漫显示与其他独立专项仍保留边界。 升级时完整替换旧目录，保留版本目录与LoadFolders.xml。旧1.7简易发射器等移除定义不提供存档迁移。Harmony与RJW先于SSC加载；文化及仪式需要Ideology。兔入口与旧RimTalk对接仍不可用。
Version 2.4.8 — Broodmother, personality imprints and management. Adds the seventh specialization, preconception/generation and birth handling, final conception scenes with eligible adult targets, PNA/body frequency sources, six disabled Hollow needs and explicit trainer/work-enabling actions. New work targets RimWorld 1.7; 1.6/Common retain frozen SSC 2.4.1 content. New Broodmother selection requires Chain stage 3 and a completed uterus. Successful conception starts a seven-day cooldown; interruption grants neither pregnancy nor success cooldown. Imprints follow personality; preconception settings belong to the body. Current Masters cannot undergo personality extraction. Trainer work is explicitly enabled at priority 3 while existing enabled priorities are preserved. Replicas, unified-framework integration and room effects remain future/deferred work. Retains personal/romance controls, moods/logs, sensitivity, PNA production, body development, culture/cosmetics, nine weapons, gel appearance and personality transfer. Scoped batch acceptance is recorded; three-language romance display and independent open checks retain their boundaries. Replace the whole old folder, retaining version folders and LoadFolders.xml. Removed old 1.7 launcher definitions have no save migration. Load Harmony/RJW before SSC; Ideology is required for culture and rituals. Rabbit selection and legacy RimTalk remain unavailable.
